text:
Maya: Quick sync — pulling together owners/dates for the RCA action items from last week's outage. Please confirm ownership or reassign by EOD. Here's the current list (pulled from notes):

```
1) Update canary runbook — owner: Sam — due: 2026-03-25 — status: proposed
2) Add KV-cache metrics to dashboard — owner: Priya — due: 2026-03-23 — status: in-progress
3) Autoscaler safety defaults (fail-open thresholds) — owner: Theo — due: 2026-03-30 — status: blocked (kernel roll dependency)
4) Production model fallback test (end-to-end) — owner: Maya — due: 2026-03-22 — status: open
5) Postmortem doc finalize + signoff — owner: Ethan — due: 2026-03-24 — status: open
```

Priya: I can take #2. I opened a PR (WIP) and added the initial dashboard panels. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-metrics — ETA Wed 03/23 for first review. Will attach screenshots to the PR once panels are stable.

Ethan: I'll finish the postmortem write-up and get sign-off from PM + SRE by Tue 03/24. If people have any lingering notes, drop them here or tag me.

Theo: Autoscaler safety is blocked on kernel roll (ENG-INFRA-451). Current window ETA for the roll is Fri 03/27 due to node image gating. If we can get an expedited image build I can move it up. @Sam fyi since canary depends on that change for the fail-open experiment.

Sam: I can own #1 (canary runbook). Will update runbook and checklist in the Runbooks repo and hand off to Maya for final approval. Targeting Thu 03/25 to land. Need a quick review from @Maya and a smoke canary window after the kernel roll. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks — couple quick asks: 
- @Priya please attach the dashboard snapshot to your PR and add the query that surfaced the regression.
- @Theo if the kernel roll needs a maintenance window we need SOC approval; please open the maint request and paste the link here.
- @Sam please include the exact canary cutoff/rollback steps in the runbook (small bullet list).

Theo: Confirmed — kernel roll will need a ~30m maintenance window for the node image swap. I'll open the maintenance request now and post the link. Appreciate patience if this slips a day.

postmortem-bot: Created tracker items PM-4321, PM-4322, PM-4323, PM-4324, PM-4325 and assigned to listed owners. Tracker view: https://tracker.internal/redwood/boards/rca-2026

Maya: Great. Quick summary of actionables from this thread (I will update the RCA doc by EOD):
- Sam -> canary runbook updates, due 2026-03-25 (PR + checklist)
- Priya -> KV-cache dashboard + screenshots, due 2026-03-23 (PR: kv-metrics)
- Theo -> open maintenance request for kernel roll + ETA, due 2026-03-27 (blocker for autoscaler safety)
- Maya -> run the production fallback test and document results, due 2026-03-22
- Ethan -> finalize postmortem doc and get sign-offs, due 2026-03-24

Please reply with "ack" if you're good with the owner/date or state new owner/date. I will follow up in the RCA doc and the tracker. :eyes:

Priya: ack — will attach screenshots and link PR here when ready.

Sam: ack — will drop canary checklist into Runbooks and ping for review.

Theo: ack — maint request created: https://ops.internal/maint/ENG-INFRA-451, ETA Fri 03/27 02:00 UTC.

Ethan: ack — will wrap up write-up tomorrow.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll close the loop in the RCA doc and mark these tracker items in PM board. If anything shifts, please update the tracker directly so the oncall/resilience team can see the status. :thumbsup:
